portInfo.description: Ravenna Civitas Cruise Port operates a dedicated cruise terminal at Molo Crociere, Porto Corsini, with two berths for simultaneous ships. AdSP’s November 2025 briefing for the 2026 season describes completion of a new maritime station (~5,000 m², two floors, 250×6 m elevated walkway) enabling two-ship operations (~7,000 pax), with 111 planned calls (71 homeport / 40 transit) and about 390,000 passenger movements (~58% above 2025). Historic Ravenna’s UNESCO monuments are inland of Porto Corsini.

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Historic Ravenna’s UNESCO monuments are inland of Porto Corsini. Not a short waterfront walk from the cruise terminal — use ship shuttle or verified coach; transfer minutes are not published on the RCCP/AdSP pages we captured. Plan mosaic visits only after transfer timing is confirmed.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: UNESCO mosaic sites (San Vitale et al.) — only after confirmed transfer from Porto Corsini.
Porto Corsini waterfront — if the ship confirms a short transfer window.
Ship excursion — safest timing when shuttle minutes are unknown.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near Porto Corsini unless the ship confirms a short shuttle round-trip to historic Ravenna.
thingsToDo.standardCall: One mosaic site or old-town block is realistic only with confirmed shuttle timing—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A wider UNESCO circuit needs confirmed transport and a long day ashore—prefer ship excursion if shuttle timing is unknown.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Porto Corsini ≠ Ravenna centro — budget transfer before mosaics.
